text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш makes her debut without a
hitch, but
she seems concerned about
something.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With so many of her contemporaries
being
standouts, she'll have to approach
the Keisei Hai
with care for any hope of
success in the Classic
Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
